purpose: Frozen Compitum v0.2.0 control baseline for the FabricPC trajectory-observer experiment (observation-only tranche).

failures.cause: known, pre-existing v0.2.0 worktree incompatibility: git_commit_short() resolves .git as a directory; in any `git worktree` checkout .git is a file, so head_file.exists() is False for real, unmutated code. Documented during the 0.2.0 release in reports/mutation_clean_verification_security.json; confirmed passing in real CI on a normal (non-worktree) clone of the same source. Orthogonal to FabricPC.
failures.disposition: recorded, not deselected, not patched -- the frozen tree stays frozen

rollback: delete the worktree branch, C:/src/FabricPC, and both venvs to return to v0.2.0 with no FabricPC installed
